body: While you review, I corrected one source-protocol conflict in the reserved draft. The split unit is now a source-lineage group; story family is a stratum with every family represented in every partition; provider selection is leave-family-out and floor fitting is leave-story-out. The nested loss now weights family stratum, source story, recall, then unit, and the stability court deletes one source-lineage group at a time. Please review the current blob, not the earlier path text.
